items.title: How many round trips a screen needs, with and without a BFF
items.description: Mobile's product page in the opening scenario needed 4 separate resource calls before it could render. Drag the number of resources a screen needs to see how that scales without a BFF aggregating them into one call.
items.compute: return { withoutBffMs: params.resourcesNeeded * params.roundTripMs, withBffMs: params.roundTripMs };

items.title: Fan-out latency: sequential vs. parallel calls inside the BFF
items.description: The buildProductPage code above fans out with Promise.all instead of sequential awaits. Drag the number of upstream calls and their typical latency to see how far apart sequential and parallel fan-out drift as a BFF aggregates more services — this reproduces the unit's 3-call, ~80ms-per-call example at its defaults.
items.compute: return { sequentialMs: params.numUpstreamCalls * params.avgLatencyMs, parallelMs: params.avgLatencyMs };
